about.metaTitle: About Us | Kantin Mega Rasa Kota Tua Jakarta
about.metaDescription: Discover the story of Kantin Mega Rasa in Old Batavia. Bringing authentic Indonesian flavors, a warm gathering room, and genuine hospitality to local and global travelers.
about.title: Kantin Mega Rasa: Indonesian Flavors in Old Batavia
about.subtitle: Reviving historical nostalgia through time-honored culinary heritage and warm hospitality
about.storyP1: Kantin Mega Rasa was founded from a passionate devotion to preserving traditional Betawi cuisine and the rich archipelago spices of Indonesia. Nestled within Jakarta's historical Old Town (Kota Tua) amidst classic Dutch colonial architecture, we serve as a welcoming haven for food lovers.
about.storyP2: We believe exploring Kota Tua's museums calls for a clean, cool, and comfortable respite where guests can enjoy comforting, authentic dishes at honest prices. Every sauce, sambal, and broth is freshly prepared each morning using natural market ingredients.
about.storyP3: As nearby offices and travel groups looked for quiet, reliable places to gather, we renovated our second floor into an exclusive, air-conditioned Event Space. Today, it has become a favored venue for corporate workshops, alumni reunions, and lively family gatherings.
about.val1Desc: Strict hygiene standards in our kitchen, dining room, and restrooms for your peace of mind.
about.val2Desc: Friendly, bilingual staff ready to assist international guests and domestic travelers.
about.val3Desc: We value the tight schedules of office lunch breaks and traveling tourists.
about.val4Desc: A fully equipped upper floor space ensuring seamless gatherings and celebrations.
